KeyPassages: Genesis 2:4; Exodus 1:1; Leviticus 2:8; Numbers 1:5; Deuteronomy 1:1; Joshua 4:6
BiblicalUsage: ʼêl-leh is a plain word for these or those. In Genesis 2:4, the text says "These [are] the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created." In Exodus 1:1, the text says "Now these [are] the names of the children of Israel."
TheologicalSignificance: Reading ʼêl-leh this way, I believe God's Word means what it says, and this word is part of how He speaks plainly to us. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
